WHILE THE OVERARCHING CONCEPT OF STAGING IS CONSISTENT—DEFINING DISEASE EXTENT AND SPREAD—THE OPERATIONAL DETAILS, INCLUDING STAGING SYSTEMS AND SPECIFIC STAGE DEFINITIONS, ARE TAILORED TO EACH CANCER TYPE. IN SUMMARY, STAGING IS NOT A SINGLE UNIFORM PROCEDURE BUT A FRAMEWORK ADAPTED TO THE ANATOMY AND BEHAVIOR OF EACH CANCER, WITH ALL APPROACHES ULTIMATELY AIMING TO QUANTIFY TUMOR BURDEN AND SPREAD.
